# Latter-Day Sex

> Latter-Day Sex ("Keep it Passionate") is a podcast for Latter-day Saints with questions about sex, desire, and intimacy. It is hosted by Dr. Susannah Pipkin and Dr. Annie Bryner, certified sex therapists who are active members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. New episodes come out weekly on YouTube and Spotify.

The show stays inside Church doctrine and is not an official Church publication. It is education and encouragement, not therapy. Sex therapy itself is strictly talk therapy.

## Episodes

- [Episode 1: Where Did the Desire Go?](https://latterdaysex.net/episodes/01-where-did-the-desire-go.html): Published Nov 2, 2026. Desire differences, shame, "duty sex," and why sex in marriage is a stewardship, not an entitlement.
- [Episode 2: Pornography and Shame in LDS Marriage](https://latterdaysex.net/episodes/02-pornography-and-shame-in-lds-marriage.html): Published Nov 20, 2026. Why pornography use is rarely just about sex, guilt vs. shame, and how couples can talk about it with openness instead of fear.
- [All episodes](https://latterdaysex.net/episodes/): Show notes, key takeaways, and links to listen.

## Topics

- [Desire differences](https://latterdaysex.net/topics/desire-differences.html): Help for Latter-day Saint couples with mismatched sex drives.
- [Sexual shame and faith](https://latterdaysex.net/topics/shame-and-faith.html): How Latter-day Saints can separate shame from doctrine.
- [Talking about sex](https://latterdaysex.net/topics/talking-about-sex.html): Practical, kind ways for couples to talk about sex, desire, and what they want.
- [Pornography](https://latterdaysex.net/topics/pornography.html): Compassionate, doctrine-aligned help with pornography, recovery, broken trust, and rebuilding intimacy.
- [Dating and engagement](https://latterdaysex.net/topics/dating-and-engagement.html): Chastity, boundaries, and preparing for a healthy sexual relationship in marriage.
- [Newlyweds and the first years](https://latterdaysex.net/topics/newlyweds-and-first-years.html): The wedding night, the first year of sex, pain, pressure, and a healthy start.
